# Independent AutoSpread numerical reference

Generated by `tools/validate_autospread_reference.py` using the published equations
in Roca et al. (2021), doi:10.1038/s41467-021-23126-8, Methods section Sec26.
The validation-only R runtime resides under `.cache/references/r-runtime`.

`controls.npz` contains independently constructed synthetic acquired intensities.
`truth.json` contains base-R regressions, type-7 quantiles, noise correction,
F-test significance and spreading coefficients. `reference.json` records source
and fixture hashes and the R runtime version. The oracle uses no production fit
functions. It uses normal equations for weighted spectral unmixing, independently
of production's pseudoinverse.

These are numerical reference fixtures, not biological controls or outputs from
the closed-source FlowJo binary. R and cached paper/source files are not packaged
in the desktop application.
